questions.ask: Your pitch says "Parents spend about 5 hours a week deciding what to cook and shopping for it", but meal-kit and grocery apps have chased that same problem for years. Why now? What changed in the last year or two that lets Tidy win where they did not, and why couldn't you have built this five years ago?
questions.quote: Parents spend about 5 hours a week deciding what to cook and shopping for it.

questions.ask: You are asking for money to "add two more grocery stores". How big does this get if it works, and what keeps it standing in 20 years? If one grocery chain or a delivery company builds the same weekly planner into its own app, what do you own that they can't copy?
